allTasks.name: 🚀 get started in 3 commands
allTasks.script:
npm i -g fscr        # 📦 install fsr globally
fsr generate         # ✨ imports your package.json scripts → fscripts.md
fsr                  # 🎯 interactive picker — choose and run

allTasks.name: build:prod
allTasks.description: 🏗️ Full production build. Cleans dist/, compiles, minifies. Takes ~2 min.
allTasks.script: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run minify

allTasks.name: 🤯 full javascript blocks — yes, really

allTasks.name: 🔐 encryption
allTasks.description: Keep secrets safe without a third-party vault 🔒:
allTasks.script:
fsr encrypt    # 🔐 password-protect any file(s)
fsr decrypt    # 🔓 unlock them when you need them

allTasks.name: 📋 table of contents
allTasks.description: Your `fscripts.md` grows fast 📈. Keep it navigable:

allTasks.name: 🩺 doctor
allTasks.script:
fsr doctor            # 🔍 check system health
fsr doctor --fix      # 🔧 auto-fix where possible
fsr doctor --json     # 📊 output results as JSON (great for CI)
fsr doctor --verbose  # 🔬 show everything
